description.value:
Prerequisites: Red Mage 12, Spell Combat class feature

When attacking with a melee power weapon, the red mage can use spell combat with it by increasing the action taken to a full-round action and by spending 1 point from his arcane pool (if it already is a full-round action it only costs the point).

system.source: Final Fantasy d20 - Red Mage (Ruby Talents)
